title: Motor-de-Velos-SCM: Reproducible Pipeline for SCM Galaxy Rotation Curve Analysis
description: Motor-de-Velos-SCM provides a reproducible, auditable pipeline to evaluate galaxy rotation curves under the SCM (Motor de Velos; Fluid Condensation) model. The repository implements end-to-end workflows covering data preprocessing, out-of-sample validation, OLS environmental analysis (F3 vs. stellar mass and Chae environment proxy), and diagnostic reporting. Validated datasets include SPARC (Lelli et al. 2016) and LITTLE THINGS.
